scope: Account-aware comparison of verified deterministic alternatives and selected monster-drop bypasses. This context ranks nothing and requires an explicit player objective before exposing an RNG path as a candidate.

bypasses.name: Rune axe from Enchanted Valley tree spirits

normal_path.description: Buy a Rune axe from Perry's Chop-chop Shop in the Woodcutting Guild.
normal_path.displaced_requirement_or_benefit: The drop can displace the modeled 60 Woodcutting guild entry and listed 40,960-coin shop purchase.

bypasses.bypass_benefit: Provides the rune Woodcutting axe tier for level-41 Woodcutting actions if the drop is observed.
stop_conditions: Do not pursue the drop solely because it is listed; stop unless the player has recorded an explicit objective.
Stop the acquisition path when Rune axe ownership is observed.
reentry_conditions: Formal action access and player-selected practical combat context are current.
Rune axe ownership is still not observed.

bypasses.name: Zombie axe from armoured zombies

normal_path.description: No deterministic alternative is recorded in the verified bypass fact.
normal_path.displaced_requirement_or_benefit: The bypass provides an observed one-handed slash and crush weapon; no deterministic requirement is claimed as displaced.

bypasses.bypass_benefit: A broken zombie axe can enter the existing repair action only after it is observed; the completed axe remains an observed result.
stop_conditions: Do not make a 1/800 drop a default route target.
Stop collection when a broken zombie axe is observed and evaluate the separately normalized repair action.
Stop the acquisition path when Zombie axe ownership is observed.
reentry_conditions: Formal action access and player-selected practical combat context are current.
Neither a broken zombie axe nor a completed Zombie axe is observed.
